messages:
Maya: heads-up — CI red on the samplekit onboarding job after typegen/regendiff step. looks like a nondeterministic sort in OpenAPI -> typegen, causing semver churn in the changelog 😕
Jonas: ugh, can you paste the regendiff output? is it just ordering or schema-level changes?
Maya: mostly ordering. small example: `paths` entries flip between runs; changelog picks it up as noise. snippet:
```
- paths/users.yml
- paths/auth.yml
+ paths/auth.yml
+ paths/users.yml
```
Maya: also saw an auth/retry fixture flake in the sample app that changes generated retry defaults, so second noise source.
devex-bot: regendiff summary for job #4217: 3 files changed (ordering), 1 file content drift (tests/auth-retry-fixture). deterministic_hash: false
Jonas: ok — two issues: 1) OpenAPI property ordering not stable, 2) sampleapp test mutates global default causing typegen change. quick mitigation: pin typegen output sorting or add a stable key comparator.
Tara: I can repro locally. which command do you run to regen?
Maya: `yarn regen:samplekit --ci` (in CI we run with NODE_ENV=ci and `--strip-metadata`)
Jonas: try this locally: `NODE_ENV=ci yarn regen:samplekit --stable-sort` — I hacked a flag to force a stable comparator. also here's the failing CI log from ci-bot:
```
ci-bot: TASK samplekit/regendiff (runner-7) FAILED
Error: Regendiff mismatch: 2 files changed
  at Regendiff.compare (/workspace/tools/regendiff/index.js:78:15)
  at processTicksAndRejections (internal/process/task_queues:95:5)
  at async run()
```
Maya: thanks. is --stable-sort something we can add to typegen by default? or should we upstream a deterministic sort to openapi-parser?
Jonas: prefer upstream in parse layer so all pipelines benefit. short-term, add `--stable-sort` to regen job in CI to mute churn until upstream landed.
Tara: also the auth/retry fixture — it stubs global config and doesn't restore defaults in one test path. I'll open a quickfix PR to reset it.
Maya: pinging @Jonas for CI change, can you adjust the publish gating so semver bump is blocked if only ordering diffs? we shouldn't auto-bump minor for churn.
Jonas: yep — I'll update the release gate rule to ignore ordering-only diffs. patch will be small (release-gate: treat regendiff ordering-only -> no semver delta).
Tara: repro steps I used:
1) clone branch
2) `yarn install`
3) `NODE_ENV=ci yarn regen:samplekit`
4) run `git status --porcelain` to see changed files
I can attach my run logs to the PR.
Maya: nice. timeline? we need this unblocked before today's publish window.
Jonas: I'll push a CI config hotfix in ~30m to add `--stable-sort` and update gating rules. Tara — plz include the test fix in a follow-up PR.
Tara: on it. will also add a unit to the typegen serializer asserting stable order to prevent regressions.
Maya: thanks team. quick note to docs: I'll add a short note in onboarding checklist: "if regen diffs appear on first-run, run `NODE_ENV=ci yarn regen:samplekit --stable-sort` and file a regendiff issue."
devex-bot: deploy plan created: devex/regen-hotfix -> CI config patch -> rollout to samplekit jobs. change owner: Jonas
Jonas: pushed config change and opened release-gate PR. CI green on new run so far :crossed_fingers:
ci-bot: build #4218: samplekit/regendiff PASSED
Maya: awesome, thanks. leaving this thread open until Tara's test PR lands.
Tara: test PR up: #4321, fixes auth fixture + adds stable-order unit. small changelog entry included.
Jonas: merged release-gate rule, patched CI. closing after one more stable run.
ci-bot: build #4220: all samplekit jobs PASSED
Maya: closing — thanks everyone :tada:
